component.name: abraflexi-tui
component.summary: Turbo Vision TUI frontend for AbraFlexi CLI

description.p: AbraFlexi TUI provides a terminal user interface for the abraflexi-cli tool, built with the Turbo Vision (tvision) library. It shells out to abraflexi-cli for all AbraFlexi connectivity and renders company, evidence, and record data in a classic text-mode UI.

ul.li: Generic, evidence-parameterized record list and detail view
Record creation with mandatory-field hints and dry-run support
Saved server profiles (password or session token) and the current request URL

description.p: First release of the Turbo Vision frontend for abraflexi-cli.
